# ColorFYI Embed Widget

> Embeddable ColorFYI widgets for any website. Zero dependencies, Shadow DOM isolation, 4 themes (light/dark/sepia/auto).

## Quick Start

Add to any HTML page:
- Script: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/colorfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>

## Links

- Main site: https://colorfyi.com
- Widget docs: https://widget.colorfyi.com
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/colorfyi-embed
- GitHub: https://github.com/fyipedia/colorfyi-embed
- API: https://colorfyi.com/developers/
